findings.title: Never-written source reservation remains DELETE_PENDING because absent parent directory is IO_FAILURE
findings.required_fix: Treat explicit NOFOLLOW missing directory as already absent, reject all other path errors

findings.title: Old upload borrows reactivated reservation revision and commits deleted object
findings.required_fix: Carry reservation generation/revision across storage I/O and match it at final commit

findings.title: Two reconcilers share deletion claim and late delete destroys new REFERENCED object
findings.required_fix: Cross-instance physical-delete fencing or generation-isolated physical objects with durable old-generation cleanup

findings.title: Missing-target reclaim recovery incorrectly requires candidate own receipt despite authorizer durable receipt
findings.required_fix: Bind recovery to actual authorizer receipt and candidate ID plus exact candidate command/result/prepared/scope/parent proof

findings.title: Oldest32 permanent RECLAIMABLE tombstones starve later real quota candidates
findings.required_fix: Durable bounded authorization progress without raising limit/deleting tombstones/directory-derived authority
